limits: The isolated matrix uses actual shipping components with deterministic scene time and session selection; audio and game background themes are absent.
Session phase transitions and completion are accelerated through the actual manager to avoid waiting through entire sessions.
The actual-application smoke runs the Vite development entry with a minimal forest background; it is separate from production-build validation.
The actual-application smoke mutes session audio using the supported audioManager.setEnabled(false) API.
Software-browser checks establish rendering, shader compatibility and resource bounds; they do not measure physical-phone or hardware GPU frame rate.

matrix.supersededUICaptures: Preparation/countdown/catalogue/completion UI evidence is replaced by the final settled UI supplement.

postMatrixSourceChanges.reason: Guided session input/settings guards and mode-exit cancellation; scene artwork unchanged.
Catch-up resolves timing before emitting one current-phase callback; scene artwork unchanged.
Dialog focus resets ancestor and overlay scroll and prevents automatic scrolling.
Guided session notice copy correction and global Hub start/stop fallback.
Completion desktop vertical padding reduced to preserve full artwork and controls.

supersededHarnessAttempts.note: These failures came from capture helpers. The final smoke corrects the hidden-switch selector, final-phase transition and audio muting API without changing shipping source.
